streaming_input.text: Under the guide, this is primarily a service request to reopen the repair, paired
with a complaint about the incorrect closure. It is not an information request, and
without a stated appeal route, it should not be treated as an appeal.
Seek corrective service action, ideally a response confirming that the work order has been reopened
and giving a repair timetable. A complaint remedy can include those steps, but the
council's acceptance and the actual repair date remain pending.
